scope: Additive owner-approved preview quota setting. Preserve existing Locked 30-second shared account cooldown, source/identity protection, private Pending verification, manual coffee entry and shot logging.

decisions.topic: Initial account-wide daily URL preview budget
decisions.decision: Start with at most 12 successful URL preview quota claims per admitted member account per 24-hour budget window, shared by known-roaster and unknown-roaster preview routes. This limit replaces the former 60-claim engineering default; it does not replace or weaken the at-least-30-second cooldown.
decisions.revision_policy: If the owner or another member reaches this limit during real use, review feedback and consider a higher limit. Do not automatically increase it or grant individual exceptions without a subsequent explicit owner decision.
decisions.unaffected: Manual Add Coffee and Log Shot remain available when automatic previews are limited. Preview never globally verifies a coffee without trusted source checks.

implementation_boundary.original_historical_ledger_objects: Retain verbatim; this decision supersedes the 60/day engineering default in current requirements only.
implementation_boundary.production: Decision approved; any production database migration requires normal change/test and release authorization. Until applied, production retains its previous 60/day setting.
implementation_boundary.window_precision: The existing counter resets 24 hours after the first claim in a window; a strict sliding per-event lookback would be a separate algorithm change. Do not silently broaden migration scope.
